title: H-d disclosure TEXT CONTENT (MD&A tone) LLM pilot
novelty_axis: material (raw disclosure TEXT), distinct from WT-D20260710_005 which killed disclosure METADATA (frequency/type = size-proxy confound)
pilot_status: power-insufficient by design; NO graduation gate claim permitted (canonical PORT_t not entered). Output = 3-value verdict + scale-up design only.

rubric.scale: integer 1-5 per axis, plus one-line rationale per axis per document
rubric.scorer: the alpha-research agent itself, in-context; NO external LLM API; excerpt <= 3000 chars per document

tone.definition: Management narrative optimism vs defensiveness. 1 = strongly defensive/negative (emphasis on crisis, losses, deterioration, apologetic framing). 3 = neutral/balanced. 5 = strongly optimistic/confident (emphasis on growth, record results, opportunity, leadership).
tone.mechanism: Loughran-McDonald 2011: net-positive MD&A tone signals credible managerial confidence -> higher subsequent returns. Sign pre-committed.

uncertainty.definition: Density of uncertainty/hedging language BEYOND the boilerplate forward-looking disclaimer. 1 = highly definitive/committed statements, few hedges. 3 = moderate. 5 = pervasive uncertainty (risk, volatility, 'may', 'could', unpredictable, contingent) in the substantive narrative.
uncertainty.mechanism: Loughran-McDonald uncertainty lexicon predicts negative drift / higher risk; managers hedge when outlook is weak. Sign pre-committed.

complexity.definition: Linguistic complexity / obfuscation of the substantive narrative. 1 = clear, concise, plain. 3 = moderate. 5 = highly complex/obfuscated (long convoluted sentences, jargon overload, vague circumlocution).
complexity.mechanism: Li 2008 (readability): managers obscure bad news with complex prose -> lower subsequent performance. Sign pre-committed.

composite.formula: composite = (tone) + (6 - uncertainty) + (6 - complexity)   [all axes sign-aligned so HIGHER composite = predicted-BETTER outlook; range 3..15]

excerpt_extraction_rule.source: DART document.xml of the ANNUAL business report (사업보고서) only
excerpt_extraction_rule.annual_filter: report_nm contains '사업보고서' AND NOT any of {기재정정, 첨부정정, 첨부추가, 정정}
excerpt_extraction_rule.section_anchor: last occurrence of literal '경영진단 및 분석의견' in tag-stripped plain text (last occ = body, not table-of-contents)
excerpt_extraction_rule.boilerplate_skip: within 2500 chars after anchor, locate '개요'; if found start = that position (skips the identical '예측정보에 대한 주의사항' disclaimer); else start = anchor + 400
excerpt_extraction_rule.rationale: the '예측정보 주의사항' block is near-identical across all firms; scoring the firm-specific '개요/경영성과' narrative isolates real content.

sampling_protocol.universe: KOSPI200 UNION KOSDAQ150 (rawdata K200==1 OR KQ150==1)
sampling_protocol.eligibility_at: month-end on-or-before the forward-return start date (= first month-end strictly after rcept_dt). Ticker must be K200|KQ150 member at that snapshot AND have 20d-avg trading value proxy (Vol*Close) available.
sampling_protocol.candidate_pool: for every eligible (Ticker, fiscal_year) with a clean 사업보고서 filing whose rcept_dt falls in filing-year window, form one candidate document. fiscal_year in 2014..2022 (filed spring 2015..2023).

strata.cap_tier: within-universe Size tercile at eligibility snapshot: LARGE (top third), MID (middle), SMALL (bottom third)

sampling_protocol.cell_target: 3 cap_tier x 3 year_bin = 9 cells x 5 docs = 45 (if a cell is short, deficit reallocated to same cap_tier other year_bins, then globally, deterministically by seed order)
sampling_protocol.selection_algorithm: deterministic: set.seed(20260711); within each cell, sample without replacement from that cell's candidate (Ticker,year) list ordered by Ticker then year; fill cell_target; reallocate deficits in fixed cell order [LARGE:bins, MID:bins, SMALL:bins].

pit_and_returns.return_construction: compound monthly Ret over the 12 months (Return.cumulative-style prod is used ONLY for a single-asset holding-period total return, permitted; no portfolio synthesis). fwd12m_total = prod(1+Ret)-1 over the 12 months; fwd12m_bench = prod(1+BM_Ret)-1 same window; fwd12m_excess = fwd12m_total - fwd12m_bench.
pit_and_returns.primary_target: fwd12m_excess (removes cross-year market-level effect since docs span 2015-2023)

measurement.statistic: Spearman rank correlation between each score axis (and composite) and fwd12m_excess (primary) / fwd12m_total (secondary)
measurement.bootstrap: resample the N scored documents with replacement, 2000 reps, 90% percentile CI on Spearman rho
measurement.size_confound_control: partial Spearman controlling for log(Size at eligibility snapshot); also report Spearman(score, log Size) to expose any size proxy. WT-005 lesson: metadata was a size proxy; verify TEXT content is not.
measurement.n_trials_family: pre-registered family = {tone, uncertainty, complexity, composite} x {excess, total} = 8 correlations; primary decision uses the 4 vs-excess correlations. n_trials logged. Small-sample pilot: NO multiple-testing graduation gate applied (verdict is directional triage, not capital).

verdict_rule_preregistered.PROMISING_SCALE_UP: for at least one of {tone, uncertainty, complexity, composite}: bootstrap 90% CI of Spearman(axis, fwd12m_excess) EXCLUDES 0 AND point-estimate sign MATCHES hypothesized_sign AND survives Size control (partial-corr keeps same sign and does not collapse toward 0 by >50%). Must ship scale-up design incl. sample size, expected cost, expected power.
verdict_rule_preregistered.WEAK: no axis meets PROMISING; but >=2 of 4 axes have point-estimate sign matching hypothesis with |rho|>0.10 and are NOT explained by Size confound (i.e. a directional whisper without CI significance).
verdict_rule_preregistered.DEAD_PRELIM: neither PROMISING nor WEAK: CIs include 0 AND (signs mostly wrong OR Size confound accounts for any apparent signal).

discipline.blind_scoring: returns are NOT loaded or computed until AFTER all scores are frozen to disk. Scoring reads excerpts-only file.
discipline.no_proxy_handcalc: no top-quintile EW / turnover*bps inline; this is a signal-content pilot not a portfolio backtest; single-asset holding-period returns only.
discipline.hash_freeze: SHA256 of this file computed and recorded before selection/scoring; post-hoc edits = contamination.
